shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical stone face
raised relief figures against a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces carry low relief on an upright stone face with figures shown in strict profile, but A depicts isolated animals (a quadruped/feline above a horned or long-snouted beast) scattered on a blank pillar face, while B depicts stacked horizontal registers of densely repeated human figures in procession carrying objects. The only correspondence is the generic convention of profile relief; the subject matter (solitary animals vs. banded human processions) and the compositional scheme (free-field vs. multiple ordered registers) differ entirely.
